items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: And Steve Wilson had that band.

ctx.x: No, no, no. Al C. Frank.

Al C. Frank played violin. And Steve Wilson had that band. Who was the drummer? Do you remember? I think they had the drummer, do you remember? I think they had the, what was the name of the phone? I think Louis Contra was playing with the band.
Louis Contra was playing with them. I just remember which one of them.
